function.name: environment_snapshot
function.description: Before giving system-specific instructions (install commands, drivers, setup), observe the parts of this machine the task needs instead of guessing: ask only for those categories (list: true names them). buddie collects what the person granted in their local grants file and the administrator's protected policy allows; anything else comes back denied, unsupported or unavailable with the reason. A request cannot grant: there is no consent argument, and an approval of this call is not a grant. The grants file states the person's intent; an agent with their file access could edit it, so only the protected policy is a ceiling it cannot change. This tool collects diagnostics categories only, never files or reports. Each observation says what it rests on (basis); unavailable means not observed, not absent. Nothing is installed or changed.

categories.description: category ids, e.g. system.os, hardware.gpu, hardware.memory, software.python, software.gpu_stack (list: true for all)

task.description: what the observation is for; kept as the caller's word, grants nothing

tools.description: software.tools: names from the catalog (list: true shows it)

path.description: hardware.storage, development.project, development.repository: a directory the person granted

list.description: only describe the categories and what is granted; collect nothing
